text:
A few days ago, a little stray cat started coming to our house and crying. We began feeding her, she slept on our porch, and little by little she started asking to come inside. We already have a cat, so we were worried about his health. We also knew that if this sweet girl became part of our family, we would never let her live on the street again. That meant we needed to take care of her health first.

Before visiting, we contacted PPT Pawpital Pet Hospital online. Everyone was very polite, replied quickly, and answered all of our questions in English. We explained that we wanted to spay the cat, and they told us that she would need vaccination first and then the spay surgery. Everything was explained clearly.

Today we visited the hospital, and we were really impressed. The clinic is very clean, modern, and comfortable. There are no bad smells, the staff are kind, and even small details like indoor slippers for visitors make the place feel welcoming.

They explained the treatment plan step by step, prepared her vaccination passport, and told us exactly when to come back for the next vaccination and her spay surgery.

They also suggested grooming because she had been living outside and still had ultrasound gel on her fur. We wanted her to come home clean so we could cuddle her without thinking about her life on the street.

While we were away, the staff sent us photos and videos of her after grooming. She was even wearing funny little sunglasses. It was such a sweet surprise. I really appreciated that they kept us updated instead of simply waiting for us to return. It made us feel that they truly cared about our cat.

After we picked her up, they explained everything again, including the next steps. Later, I also had a few questions about parasite treatment and contacted them again. They answered quickly and explained everything clearly. I really appreciate that because I am still learning about these things.

Now our beautiful girl is home, clean, healthy, and with her vaccination passport. We are very happy with our experience and will definitely continue bringing both of our cats to PPT Pawpital Pet Hospital.

Thank you to the whole team for your professionalism, kindness, and genuine care for animals. We highly recommend this hospital.
